Digital India and Healthcare eyed as future growth drivers

India's next phase of economic growth is anticipated to be driven by advancements in digital infrastructure and the healthcare sector. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) highlighted the role of Artificial Intelligence, semiconductors, and digital public infrastructure in achieving this growth. Concurrently, the healthcare sector in Tier-II and Tier-III cities is also identified as a significant area for future expansion.
